title: Warp section frame
description: The frame every section sits in: a full-width hairline on top with small ink ticks hanging at six column guides, faint vertical guides, a dotted margin outside a plain centre column, and black tabs at both window edges level with the heading. The heading is a typed '# TAG [STATUS]' line, a large mono title with open leading and a muted lead, with an optional button at the right. The content rises 12px and fades in as it enters the window.
notes: the reveal and the typed tag are CSS scroll-driven animations; browsers without them (and reduced motion) show everything in place
tone brand turns the whole band brand-coloured with white dots (for a highlighted section)
also exports WarpGuides, the column guides alone, for blocks that draw their own section
all warp blocks subtract var(--warp-squeeze) from their letter-spacing: 0.1em in the warp theme (its mono runs wide), 0 under other themes
name: warp-section

props.name: id
props.description: anchor id, so sub-navigation links can jump here

props.name: tag
props.description: the small uppercase label above the title, typed in after a "#"

props.name: status
props.description: a status shown in brackets after the tag once it is typed, e.g. "online"

props.name: pending
props.description: what the brackets hold while the tag is being typed

props.name: leadTone
props.description: colour of the lead: muted ink, or the brand colour

props.name: action
props.description: a button shown at the right of the heading (under it on phones)

props.name: tone
props.description: page: the page colour with a dotted margin · brand: a brand-coloured band with white dots

props.name: marks
props.description: draw the black tabs at the window edges level with the heading (on by default with a tag)

props.name: children
props.description: the section's content, under the heading

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: classes for the content column (e.g. a different vertical padding)
